# Morphometic analysis
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import

jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them

spores <- Momocs::import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)
out_spores <- Momocs::Out(spores)
out_spores <- Momocs::coo_center(out_spores)
out_spores_scaled <- Momocs::coo_scale(out_spores)
out_spores_smoothed <- Momocs::coo_smooth(out_spores_scaled, n = 5)
# Ensure all outlines have the same number of points (e.g., 100 points per outline)
out_spores_interp <- Momocs::coo_interpolate(out_spores_smoothed, n = 120)
# Now apply Procrustes alignment
out_spores_aligned <- Momocs::fgProcrustes(out_spores_interp)
# Visualize to confirm
panel(out_spores_aligned, title = "Aligned Amanita Spores after Resampling")
efourier_spores <- Momocs::efourier(out_spores_scaled, nb.h = 10, norm = TRUE)
pca_spores <- Momocs::PCA(efourier_spores)

```

# Volume (size) analysis

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Load data and tree
# -------------------------------
tree <- read.nexus("Analyses/Phylogeny_integrated/species_tree_output.tree")
```

```{r}


df <- read_csv("Analyses/Phylogeny_integrated/2_Open_weather_Analysis_MASTER.csv")

```

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Clean and summarize data
# -------------------------------
# Remove missing species or PC1

# Clean species names in your data frame
df$species <- df$species %>%
  stringr::str_trim() %>%      # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
  stringr::str_to_lower()      # Convert to lower case

# Clean tree tip labels
tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  stringr::str_trim() %>%
  stringr::str_to_lower()

# Now proceed with your summarizing and matching
df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC1)) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarize(
    PC1 = mean(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_length = mean(avg_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_width = mean(avg_width, na.rm = TRUE),
    volume = mean(avg_volume_estimated, na.rm = TRUE),
    rainfall = mean(Precipitation_monthly, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(volume)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(df_clean) <- df_clean$species
df_clean$species <- NULL

# Now matching will be robust
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))
```

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Match tree tips and data
# -------------------------------
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, rownames(df_clean))
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_in_both))
df_pruned <- df_clean[species_in_both, ]

# Ensure order matches
df_pruned <- df_pruned[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, rownames(df_pruned)), ]
stopifnot(rownames(df_pruned) == tree_pruned$tip.label)

```

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Phylogenetic Signal Tests
# -------------------------------
# Blomberg’s K
K_PC1 <- phylosig(tree_pruned, df_pruned$PC1, method = "K", test = TRUE)
K_volume <- phylosig(tree_pruned, df_pruned$volume, method = "K", test = TRUE)

# Pagel’s λ
comp_data <- comparative.data(tree_pruned, df_pruned, names.col = "row.names", vcv = TRUE)
lambda_PC1 <- pgls(PC1 ~ 1, data = comp_data, lambda = "ML")
lambda_volume <- pgls(volume ~ 1, data = comp_data, lambda = "ML")

summary(lambda_PC1)
summary(lambda_volume)

```

```{r}

# -------------------------------
# Plotting
# -------------------------------
# Trait vs Environment
ggplot(df_pruned, aes(x = rainfall, y = PC1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Rainfall vs PC1 (Spore Shape)", x = "Monthly Rainfall (mm)", y = "PC1 (Shape)")

# -------------------------------
# Save results (optional)
# -------------------------------
save(tree_pruned, df_pruned, K_PC1, lambda_PC1, file = "Amanita_phylo_analysis.RData")


```
